Hi Elena — thanks again for the time today. I wanted to send over the draft estimate and a short recap while it's fresh. Attached: Redwood_Estimate_NeonHealth_v1.pdf.

Recap of what we heard on the call:
- Primary goal: accelerate clinical-note summarization in our patient intake flow (throughput peak ~120 concurrent sessions).
- Data residency: US only; STS-integrated S3 for logs.
- SLO: 95th pct latency < 250ms for short responses; bursty peaks at 8–10k tokens/min.

Recommendation (initial):
- Redwood Dedicated (medium pool) + prefix KV caching to keep unit costs down for repetitive prompts.
- Estimated committed capacity: 4 x A40-equivalent GPUs (monthly commit) + burst option.
- Pricing (monthly committed): ~$18,500 / month (see attached line items and assumptions).

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm you received the estimate (attached)
2) Quick 15-min screen share where I walk through the assumptions and capacity model so we can tighten numbers
3) If procurement needs anything up front, I can also pull the draft SOW and a short SOC 2 checklist.

Suggested 15-min slots (PDT): Mon 4/19 9:30–9:45, Tue 4/20 11:00–11:15, Wed 4/21 2:00–2:15. If none work, share a couple times that do.

Thanks — happy to adjust based on priority.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Elena — thanks. Quick reply to both items and attaching a small capacity model: capacity_model.xlsx.

1) Peak vs avg assumptions:
- Avg token rate in model: 1,200 tokens/min (baseline).
- Peak bursts modeled at 8,000 tokens/min (10–15 minute windows).
- The committed pricing covers baseline with autoscaling to handle peaks; line-item in the PDF shows both baseline and incremental burst egress costs.

2) Security / retention summary (short):
- SOC 2 Type II: available on request (I can share the report via our secure portal)
- Retention: customer logs stored in customer-managed S3 by default; retention policy configurable; we recommend 90-day rolling for debug + 365-day archive when needed.
- Key management: supports AWS KMS/HSM for keys.

Aditya — looping you in; if there's flexibility on the first-month pilot pricing I mentioned, can you confirm?

If helpful, I can walk through the capacity_model.xlsx live — same 15-min slots I'm proposing earlier.
